'''Jestian Redhill''' was an [[Aes Sedai]].

==History==
[[Faile]] mentions Jestian, [[Isebaille Tobanyi]] and [[Mashera Donavelle]] as examples of an Aes Sedai who would do anything the [[White Tower]] told her to do.
